name: Kobayashi Shuzo
about: Kobayashi Shuzo has brewed in Oyama, Tochigi, since 1872, in the former Mitamura district of rice fields and wells. It makes Hououbiden, a ginjo sake, with water that reaches the brewery through the ground from the Nikko mountains.
It signs regional contracts with rice growers in the places where each rice variety began, so that each bottle shows where its rice came from. It also makes a spirit stored in Nikko oak casks.
